tests.test: No look-ahead: weights up to 2015-06 ignore all prices from 2015-06 on
Negative control: the same test catches a look-ahead version (lag 0)
Weights: each sleeve 0% or its target weight, cash = the rest
All series start at exactly 1 on 2004-12-31
Sharpe annualised with sqrt(12) on excess returns
Beta and alpha equal an OLS fit (np.polyfit)
Currency direction: EUR return = (1 + r_USD) S_t-1 / S_t - 1 (SPY, Jun 2010)
Bond hedge: IEF in EUR = USD return + EUR rate - USD rate
Zero cost: net return = gross return
No hidden rebalancing: B1 pays for its monthly trades back to the target weights
Risk-free rate used: EUR cash rate present in every month
Same Table 1 as our earlier, separately written backtest (within 0.1 pp and 0.01)
